# Analytics Module Mocks

This directory contains auto-generated mocks for the analytics module's repository interfaces.

##  Important: DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY

All files in this directory are **auto-generated by mockery**. Any manual changes will be overwritten.

## Generating Mocks

### Regenerate Analytics Mocks Only

```bash
make mocks-analytics
```

### Regenerate All Mocks

```bash
make mocks
```

## Available Mocks

- `MockMetricRepository` - For metrics collection and storage

## Usage in Tests

```go
import (
    "github.com/basilex/promenade/internal/modules/analytics/usecase/mocks"
)

func TestMetricUseCase_RecordMetric(t *testing.T) {
    // Create mock
    mockRepo := new(mocks.MockMetricRepository)

    // Set expectations
    mockRepo.On("Store", mock.Anything, mock.AnythingOfType("*entity.Metric")).Return(nil)

    // Use in test...
    mockRepo.AssertExpectations(t)
}
```

## When to Regenerate

Run `make mocks-analytics` after:

- Adding new methods to `MetricRepository`
- Changing method signatures
- Modifying return types

## Commercial Module

Analytics is a commercial module requiring a valid license. See [internal/modules/analytics/README.md](../../README.md) for details.
